subject: Deep technical session — missed slot & next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@orchid.ai>, Platform Ops <ops@orchid.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Deep technical session — proposed 30m slot (Redwood <> Orchid)

Hi Alyssa / Orchid platform team,

Thanks for taking the initial intro last week. Rishi, Monica and I would like to run a focused 30-minute technical deep-dive to review how Redwood Inference would fit into Orchid's inference pipeline and call out any constraints up front. Goal is to surface any integration blockers and agree on next engineering steps.

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 5m quick intros and scope
- 10m Redwood runtime + KV/cache and routing overview (relevant to your scaling patterns)
- 10m mapping to your infra (auth, VPC/KMS, deployment mode options)
- 5m next steps / action items

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Jul 1, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Jul 2, 11:00–11:30 PT

Can you confirm which of these works, or share two windows that week that fit your team? If helpful I can send a calendar invite — calendaring link: https://cal.com/tessa/redwood-deep-tech-30

Attaching a short session agenda and our product deck for context.

Attachments: session-agenda.pdf, redwood-inference-deck.pptx

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0148
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@orchid.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Platform Ops <ops@orchid.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deep technical session — proposed 30m slot (Redwood <> Orchid)

Hi Tessa — thanks for the note and the materials. We’re in a release freeze the week of Jul 1 due to a cross-team rollout, so those two slots won’t work for our engineering leads.

Who from your side should attend? I want to make sure we have the right people on our side (ML infra lead + platform eng). If you can’t do the week of Jul 6, a recording would also be helpful.

Proposed: week of Jul 6 (any morning PT) — let me know what you can do and I’ll try to lock it in.

—Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform | Orchid Labs
alyssa.chen@orchid.ai

Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deep technical session — proposed 30m slot (Redwood <> Orchid)

Thanks Alyssa — understood on the release freeze. From Redwood: Rishi (solutions lead) and Monica (customer success/implementation) will join; I’ll run the demo and mapping.

Week of Jul 6 we can do mornings PT. Two concrete options:
- Tue Jul 7, 10:30–11:00 PT
- Thu Jul 9, 09:00–09:30 PT

If either works I’ll send a calendar invite to the people you mention (ML infra lead + platform eng). If you prefer a recording first I can run the session with only our engineers and share the recording + short timestamped notes.

Also re-attaching a trimmed agenda to keep the call tight (session-agenda.pdf).

Let me know which option you prefer and I’ll lock it in.

Best,
Tessa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@orchid.ai>, Platform Ops <ops@orchid.ai>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — missed today's 10:00 PT slot / recording + next steps

Hi Alyssa / team — we had the Jul 1 10:00 PT invite on the calendar for the deep technical session and were on standby for the call but didn't see any of your engineers join. I just wanted to check whether the release freeze unexpectedly extended or if you’d like us to reschedule.

I recorded the short walkthrough we prepared and uploaded it to a private link here: https://redwood.ai/recordings/DEAL-8743-session1 (password: orchid123). The recording is ~28 minutes and includes the demo and mapping notes.

Next steps I propose (pick one):
- Option A: Reschedule a live 30m session w/ your ML infra lead and platform eng — suggested times (PT): Tue Jul 7 10:30 or Thu Jul 9 09:00
- Option B: We share the recording and a one-page tech mapping, then set a short 15m sync for clarifying Qs the following week

If you confirm a preferred option I’ll create the calendar invite and include a short mutual action plan so we can keep the deal moving.

FYI — I’m looping in Rishi (solutions lead) and Monica (CS) for scheduling and to pick up any action items.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0148
